Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! Ross Taylor leads his team out to the middle and the crowd cheers on doing so. An emotional moment for him! Stephan Myburgh and Max O'Dowd will open the batting for Netherlands. Matt Henry will begin with the new ball. Let's go!
... THE RUN CHASE ...

Right then! The Netherlands need to chase 334 runs to end this series on a positive note. They will be up against a strong bowling attack though. Will they manage to pull this off? Do join us in a short while to find out.

Martin Guptill (106) comes up for a quick chat. Says that it was tough at the start and the plan with Will Young was to create a partnership and take it as deep as possible for the other batters to have a platform. On Ross Taylor, Guptill replies that it's been a great career and he has loved every bit of it.

The Netherlands got off to a good start, they got an early breakthrough, but then failed to capitalize on the same. They did add some sort of pressure at the start, but could not grab wickets. The bowlers had to toil hard on the field today and they were rewarded only towards the last 10 overs. They grabbed quick wickets and were on the road to recovery, but then lost their way once again. They leaked 106 runs in the last 10 overs but the silver lining was that they also grabbed 6 wickets. Although things could have been a lot worse for them. Not the best day with the ball, they gave away 12 wides and 4 no balls as well. Their batting has not been the best in this series, and now they have to chase down a mammoth total to get over the line. A challenging task for the batters now!

A good toss to win! After losing Henry Nicholls early on in the innings, Martin Guptill and  Will Young were batting watchfully on a sticky wicket and carefully planned their partnership. It was a measured approach from them initially and after the second Drinks break, they decided to attack more. Their massive double century stand put the Dutch team under immense pressure. But both perished soon after notching up their centuries. Tom Latham, Doug Bracewell, and Ish Sodhi played blistering cameos and guided their side to a total of 333! They will be mighty pleased and will be eyeing a clean sweep from here!

End of a scintillating batting performance from New Zealand! They have put a healthy total of 333 on the board, after getting off to a rather slow start. The Netherlands will be disappointed, they did manage to pull things back but lost their way towards the end again. They have a mountain to climb now.
Fuller one, around leg, Jamieson clears his front leg and hammers it down to long on for a couple of runs. New Zealand finish on 333/8!

FOUR! Misfield there and the bowler is not happy. Full in length, around middle, Jamieson shapes up for a big heave but it takes the outside edge. Michael Rippon, at short third man, thinks to go for the catch but then pulls out at the last moment. It lands and sneaks past him to find the fence.
Another yorker, around off, Sodhi keeps it out from the inside half his bat. It ricochets off his back pad to the off side and they cross.
A near-yorker around middle and leg, Kyle fails to keep it out. It deflects off his pads and they cross for a leg bye.
Kyle Jamieson walks out to bat.

OUT! Caught behind! Logan van Beek serves it on a fuller length and wide outside off, at 130.1 kph, Tom shuffles across the stumps and falls in the process of heaving it across the line. Gets a feather touch and Scott Edwards, the keeper, takes an easy catch. The appeal is made and the finger has gone up. Latham has an embarrassed smile on his face as he returns.
Commentary.Howout: c Scott Edwards b Logan van Beek

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Poor line and length with the field set. Delivers it on a length and outside off, Latham gets on the front foot and with a good extension of his arms, he smashes it over mid off for a boundary.
Logan van Beek will bowl the final over of the innings!
A touch short and on off, Latham turns and plays a short-arm jab to send it to deep mid-wicket. A single taken, 15 from the over. 6 balls left. How many more can the Kiwis get?
Fred Klaassen comes from 'round the wicket and digs in a short ball on middle, Ish pulls it to deep square leg for a run.
FOUR! This one is properly smacked! Back of a length, around leg, Ish Sodhi clears his front leg and muscles it down to cow corner for a boundary.
Wide! Full toss, down the leg side, Sodhi fails to connect.

SIX! That looked like a mishit but has gone the distance. Fuller in length, wide outside off at 115.2 kph, Sodhi throws his bat at it and gets a big top edge. The ball keeps on flying and clears long off.
Back of a length, around off, Tom punches it through covers for a single.
Slower length ball, around leg, it's tickled away to deep square leg for a run.
Ish Sodhi comes to the crease now.

OUT! BRILLIANTLY CAUGHT! Full and floated, around leg, Doug Bracewell goes down on one knee and tries to power it over square leg. He gets more height than distance and Bas de Leede takes a fine low catch, diving forward across to his right, at deep mid-wicket. The umpires get it checked upstairs and the replays find that the fingers are wrapped under the ball. That's brilliant, neat and clean. A wonderful cameo from Doug Bracewell comes to an end.
Commentary.Howout: c Bas de Leede b Aryan Dutt

Commentary.Commentary: SIX! Smashed! Too easy this time. Flatter and wide outside off, short in length, Doug latches onto the width and rifles it all the way over wide long off.

SIX! High and long! 300 up for New Zealand! Flighted and full, outside off, Doug Bracewell swings his bat at it and sends it flying over long on for a biggie. That went a mile but just cleared the fence.
PUT DOWN! Flatter delivery, full and on middle at 93.7 kph, Latham drives it back to the bowler, it's aerial but bursts through the hands of Dutt. It goes down the ground and they take one.
FOUR! Quality! Loopy and full, landing around off, Tom Latham steps back to create room and lofts it nonchalantly over extra cover for a boundary.
Play and a miss! Quicker and fuller, outside off, Latham tries to play the slog-sweep but misses.

FOUR! Put away! Pace up from Fred, clocks 132 clicks but bowls it short and down the leg side, Doug Bracewell swivels on the back foot and pulls it easily down to fine leg for a boundary. 14 from the over, New Zealand are 11 away from the 300-run mark!
Lets out a big grunt and delivers a slower one at 116.5 kph, around off and short in length, Tom taps it down to point for a run.
FOUR! Neatly done! Back of a length, around off at 129 kph, Latham walks across the stumps and spoons it over the keeper for a boundary.
Serves it full and on middle, Doug shows the full face of the bat and drills it down to long on for a single.
Fine leg drops back. Third man comes up...
Shortish and outside off, played down to backward point for one.
Slower one again, a bit short and around off, Latham nudges it around to mid-wicket and steals a couple of runs.
Wide! Back of a length, around leg and sliding down the leg side, Latham tries to glance but misses.
Fred Klaassen is back on.
Eases a full ball down to wide long on and scampers back for the second run.
Around off, tapped down to point for a single.
Short in length and outside off, Bracewell goes back and cuts it to deep point for a single.
Gets on the front foot and drives it through extra cover for a run.
Fuller and quicker on off, Doug gets across the stumps and works it behind square leg for a run.
Flatter and on off, pushed to covers for a run.
Shorter ball, around middle, Tom Latham swivels and pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a single. He gets off the mark with that single and will retain the strike as well!
Play and a miss! Fuller delivery, outside off, spins away a tad. Tom Latham hangs back and tries to cut this away, but he misses.
Loopy delivery, full, outside off. Tom Latham leans and blocks it out.
Tom Latham, the skipper of New Zealand, walks out to bat now.

OUT! STUMPED DOWN THE LEG SIDE! Smart bowling from Floyd. He senses the charge from the batter and smartly dishes it out down the leg side, Michael dances down the track but the ball turns down and beats his bat. The keeper collects the ball and breaks the stumps. They appeal and it's referred upstairs. The third umpire first checks for the involvement of the bat but it's missing. The side-on angle then shows that Michael's bat is in the air when the stumps were broken. Called a wide as well but the Netherlands won't mind that extra, at least. A wonderful passage of play for the Dutch, they have forced a mini-collapse!
Commentary.Howout: st Scott Edwards b Clayton Floyd

Commentary.Commentary: Appeal for a stumping...
Skidding down the leg side, Doug helps it behind square leg for one.
Doug Bracewell joins Michael Bracewell in the middle.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Two wickets in two overs for Netherlands! New Zealand have lost half their side now. Clayton Floyd strikes and gets rid of Colin de Grandhomme! A fuller ball, outside off, spins away just a tad. Colin de Grandhomme stays in his crease and tries to cut this away, but he manages to get a slight outside edge back to the keeper. Scott Edwards takes a sharp catch behind the stumps and Colin de Grandhomme walks back to the hut!
Commentary.Howout: c Scott Edwards b Clayton Floyd

Commentary.Commentary: Shorter ball, outside off. Colin de Grandhomme hangs back and slices it uppishly towards sweeper cover for a brace.
Walks forward, adjusts with the flight nicely and helps it to mid-wicket for a single. Another top over from this end!
Flatter off spinner, around off, Colin de Grandhomme tries to flick it away but misses.
Fires in a quicker and fuller ball around off, Michael Bracewell pushes it to covers and crosses.
Flighted and full, around off and drifting in, Colin hits it down to long on and opens his account with a single.
Colin de Grandhomme arrives. The situation is tailor-made for his style of batting.

OUT! Given lbw! Aryan Dutt comes into the attack and grabs a big wicket here! The Netherlands are pulling things back at the end. A shorter ball, a quicker one, the ball spins in after pitching around off. Will Young stays in his crease and looks to flick this away, but he misses and gets rapped on the pads. A huge appeal for LBW, and the umpire raises his finger. Will Young has reviewed it. Looks plumb. The UltraEdge shows no bat and the Ball Tracking returns three reds. A big breakthrough for the Netherlands as they get rid of a set batter at this stage of the match.
Fuller delivery, around middle. Will Young works it away toward long on for a brace.
Aryan Dutt (3-0-20-0) is into the attack now.
Fuller in length this time, on the pads. Michael Bracewell flicks it towards deep square leg for a couple of runs.
Good-length delivery now, outside off. Will Young pushes it towards point and takes a single.
A fuller ball, outside off. Will Young pushes it towards covers for a brace.

OUT! CAUGHT AND BOWLED! Logan van Beek strikes and he gets the wicket of Ross Taylor. A fuller ball, around middle at 111 kph. Ross Taylor gets down on his knee and tries to smack this across the line but the ball goes off the top edge towards the leg side. Logan van Beek runs there, keeps his eyes on the ball and pouches it safely at mid-wicket. A man famous for his slog-sweeps departs while attempting that in his final international outing. Everyone standing in appreciation, clapping and applauding a very decorated career. Emotional moment for Rosco and he is doing his best to hide his tears - and we get to see the tongue-poke also. Tears rolled down the cheeks of his mother though in the stands. It's a proud moment for her as well.
Michael Bracewell walks in next.
Wide! And once again! This is even wider now, full in length. Ross Taylor lets that go through this time. Wide given!
Wide! Wide of off this time, fuller ball. Ross Taylor swings his bat at it but he misses. Wide called!
Well bowled! A yorker-length delivery, outside off. Ross Taylor digs it out.
Fuller length delivery, around off. Will Young looks to drive this on the off side, but the ball goes off the inner half of the bat towards the leg side. Single taken!
A low full toss, outside off. Ross Taylor leans and drives it towards the fielder at cover. Top over from the Dutch skipper, only 4 runs from it.
Pitches it up again, tosses it up, around middle. Will Young sweeps it toward deep square leg. Single taken! 250 up for New Zealand!
Very full now, around off. Ross Taylor drills it down to long off for a single.
Slower through the air, full, around middle and leg. Ross Taylor gets down on his knee to sweep this but he misses and gets hit on his thigh pad.
Fuller delivery again, around middle and leg. Will Young gets down on his knee and sweeps it towards deep square leg for a single.
Pieter Seelaar serves a fuller ball from over the wicket, around middle. Ross Taylor slogs it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Pieter Seelaar comes back into the attack. 0 for 23 in his 4 overs so far.
Too full on this occasion, outside off. Ross Taylor drills it towards deep cover for a single. He retains the strike! 19 runs off the over!
Fuller delivery, outside off. Will Young drives it towards covers for a single.
SIX! KABOOM! Logan van Beek drops it short now, around middle and off. Will Young picks up the length, and pulls it over deep square leg for a maximum!
FOUR! Cheeky! Will Young is having fun out there now! A fuller ball, around off. Will Young shuffles across, and paddle scoops this towards fine leg for a boundary.
Shorter ball, width on offer. Ross Taylor slaps it towards deep cover for a single.
SIX! BANG! And the crowd erupts! A fuller ball, around off. Ross Taylor gets low, clears his front foot, and smashes it over deep mid-wicket for a biggie. That 'famous' slog from Rosco!
End of Powerplay 2! There will be 5 fielders allowed outside the circle now. Also, Logan van Beek comes back to bowl.

SIX! Will Young also brings up his century in style, with a biggie! This is his second ODI hundred, both coming in this ODI series. Fuller one, around middle, doesn't matter which way it's turning once Will is down to the pitch of the delivery. He has everything in control and just dispatches it over long on for a maximum. The crowd is loving every moment.
Wrong 'un around off, Taylor picks it and tickles it to square leg for a run.
Fuller and on off, driven back to the bowler.
Big spin into the batter from outside off, Taylor draws forward and across to flick but misses. He is hit on the pads but the impact is outside off.
Turning away from the batter, on a shorter length, Young goes back and punches it past the bowler for a run as it rolls away to long on.
Too full in length, around off, Taylor knocks it down to long on and the crowd again screams in joy as he takes a single.

Short and on off, Taylor controls the bounce well and pulls it to deep square leg for a run. Retains strike much to the delight of the crowd. Poor Will Young, he is on 94 but the spotlight is on Rosco.
Fuller and around leg, at 135.6 kph, Young fails to flick and it goes off his pads to square leg. They cross for a leg bye.
Short again, outside off, played down to point.
Rosco is away in his final international match. The crowd rejoice. Every run will be cheered. Short in length and outside off, Taylor cuts it through point for a single.
Ross Taylor seems to have hurt his finger. The physio is out there to have a check on him. He seems fine and we are good to resume!
Extra bounce again, from a good length around middle, Taylor is hit on the gloves as he tries to defend. It rolls away to point. Rosco seems to have hurt his fingers.
Ross Taylor comes out to bat for one last time. The crowd applauds as he walks out. A big moment for him and the Dutch players give him a guard of honour!

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Fred Klaassen bends his back and surprises the batter with a bouncer. It's a slower one at 121.5 kph but has extra bounce. Martin Guptill turns to pull but it takes the top edge and flies behind. Scott Edwards, the keeper, moves across to his left and takes the catch. They appeal, the finger is up and Guptill exits after a wonderful century. The 171-run stand is broken. The replays, later on, show that it came off the gloves.
Commentary.Howout: c Scott Edwards b Fred Klaassen

Commentary.Commentary: A touch short and on middle, Martin Guptill gets back and works it to mid-wicket for a single. 10 from this over, 40 in the last 4.
Fuller and on middle, hammered past the bowler for a run down the ground.
Eases it down to long on and takes a single.
Flighted, landing outside leg, Guptill tries to sweep but misses. He is hit on the pads, the bowler appeals but the umpire disagrees.

SIX! Guptill brings his century in style, his 17th in ODIs and the crowd roars. Off comes the helmet and there is a big smile on his face. Fuller in length and outside off, Martin Guptill presses forward and lifts it cleanly over wide long off for a maximum. He raises his bat and enjoys the ovation. Get ready, Netherlands, for an onslaught!
Turns it off his pads to square leg for a run.
Michael Rippon (5-0-36-0) comes back to bowl.
Short and outside off, slower one, Young chops it down wide of short third man for a run. 8 from this over, make it 30 in the last three.
FOUR! Take that for a reply. A thunderous blow. Full and around off, Young latches onto it and smashes it over the bowler's head for a boundary. He also moves into the 90s!
Ouch! Surprises the batter with a steep bounce. Back of a length, around middle, rears up, Young fails to move away from the line and takes a blow on his gloves.
Width there again, short and outside off, Young steers it through point for a couple of runs. 200 comes up!
Back of a length, outside off, Will hangs back and tries to guide it past short third man but finds the fielder instead.
Moves to 98! Full and on middle, Guptill nudges it towards mid on and takes a single.
Fred Klaassen (6-0-23-1) is back on!

FOUR! Well played! Fuller and around off, long on is up and Will Young is aware. He goes after it and lifts it over that fielder for a boundary. 14 from the over, 22 in the last two. There has been a momentum shift after the Drinks break. More intent from the Kiwis.
Fuller and around off, eased through cover-point for a single.
FOUR! Nicely placed! Poor delivery, short and wide outside off with third man up inside the circle. Guptill waits and guides it through the gap between short third man and backward point.
Wide called for height! A short ball around off with steep bounce, Guptill tries to jump and ramp it over the keeper but misses.
Short and on off, Will comes down the track and pushes it to extra cover for a run.
Another short delivery, again it's pulled by Martin but this time straight towards the fielder at deep mid-wicket. Only a run.
Short in length and on off, Guptill pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a couple of runs. Moves into the 90s!
Marginally short now, outside off. Will Young cuts it towards the cover-point fielder.
Much fuller this time, outside off. Will Young drives but finds the fielder at mid off.
Touch shorter again, outside off. Martin Guptill pushes it past cover for a single.
Shorter delivery, outside off. Martin Guptill taps it towards cover.

Fuller ball, outside off. Will Young pushes it towards mid off and scampers through to the other end. The fielder there does well to stop the ball. He throws the ball at the non-striker's end, but he misses.
SIX! Top shot! A half-tracker, around middle, Will Young steps down and heaves it over deep mid-wicket for a biggie! Six off the first ball, pressure on the bowler!

Drinks break. Smooth sailing for the Kiwis. The second-wicket stand is worth 163 runs and both Martin Guptill and Will Young are going strong. They have adopted a measured approach which is needed on this surface and are preparing a handy launchpad for the backend. The Netherlands have tried hard but without much success. Can they limit the damage?
Pitches it up, outside off. Martin Guptill drives but finds the fielder at mid off.
Scrambled seam, full and on off, knocked down to mid on.
Whoa! This one shoots off from a shortish length. Steep bounce and Martin Guptill is taken by surprise. It's around off, Guptill withdraws his bat at the last moment.
Fuller delivery, around middle. Will Young pushes it towards long on for a single.
No ball! Fuller ball, darting it on the pads. Martin Guptill tucks it towards square leg. Bas de Leede has overstepped and a no ball is called! Free Hit loading...

Caught? Nopes, the fielder has released the ball. Bas de Leede drops it short now, around middle, Will Young pulls it towards deep mid-wicket. Max O'Dowd takes the catch but isn't aware where the boundary cushion is. He thought he is falling over the rope and released the ball. The replays show that he had more room to work with. Was standing a few steps ahead. Anyway, a good attempt, could have been a smart attempt. A single is added to the scoreboard.
Bas de Leede pitches it up, around middle, Martin Guptill pushes it with the inner half off his bat towards long on for a single.
Bas de Leede (4-0-18-0) is back on.
Much fuller on this occasion, outside off. Martin Guptill drives it towards cover for a single. He retains the strike!
Shorter delivery, outside off. Will Young steps down the pitch, but he does not get to the pitch of the ball and ends up cutting it towards third man off the outside edge. They cross for a single.
Fuller delivery, around middle, Martin Guptill knocks it towards long on for a single.
Fuller ball, quicker this time, outside off. Martin Guptill goes for the sweep again, but he misses it this time.
Fuller, slower through the air, around off. Martin Guptill sweeps it towards deep square leg for a brace.
Pitches it up, spinning away, outside off. Martin Guptill gets beaten on his defense.
Fuller, outside off. Will Young stays in his crease and looks to guide this away but he misses. 8 from the over!
Quicker and flatter, on the pads. Will Young nudges it towards square leg.

Another full delivery, slower through the air, around middle. Will Young sweeps it across the line aerially towards deep mid-wicket. The ball goes towards Max O'Dowd at deep mid-wicket, who fumbles to collect the ball on the bounce as well. Two taken!
Fuller, outside off. Martin Guptill gets down on his knee and sweeps it towards deep square leg for a single.
FOUR! Up and over! Fuller ball, slower through the air, turning in, around off. Martin Guptill lifts it over the fielder at mid off for a boundary. The 150-run stand comes up between the two!
Shorter ball, turning in, around middle and leg. Will Young tucks it towards square leg for a single.
Fuller ball, outside off. Martin Guptill taps it towards short third man. He wanted a single there, but Will Young sends him back.
Shorter ball, spinning away, outside off. Will Young knocks it down to long off and takes a single.
Swing a miss! Much quicker this time, flatter, outside off. Will Young stays in his crease and looks to cut this away, but he misses.
Another short deliver, turning away, outside off. Martin Guptill punches it to deep cover and rotates the strike.
Much shorter now, spinning away, outside off. Will Young pushes it off the back foot towards sweeper cover for a single.
Quicker ball, full, around middle. Will Young taps it towards point.
Shortish and on off, Young goes back and turns it around the corner for a run at short fine leg. 30 gone, New Zealand are 154/1. Can they double their score from here?

SAFE! Aryan Dutt fires it in, very full and darting in around leg, Guptill gets down to sweep but misses. He is hit on the pads and the ball deflects towards short fine leg. They cross as the bowler appeals. The finger has stayed down and after consulting his players, Pieter Seelaar has taken the review. Nothing on the UltraEdge. The Ball Tracking finds it to be MISSING THE STUMPS. The Netherlands lose a review.

Review! Netherlands have reviewed an LBW decision against Martin Guptill! There is no bat involved confirms UltraEdge. Ball Tracking indicates that was sliding down leg. Martin Guptill survives and the Netherlands lose a review!
Fuller and on off, swept behind square leg for one.
Turning in from outside off, Guptill eases it to mid-wicket and rotates the strike.
Flighted off spinner outside off, tapped down to short third man for one. 150 up for the Black Caps.
Loopy and full, around off, Guptill works it with the spin to backward square leg for a run.
Uses the angle of the bowler and works a length ball to square leg. Dot ball to finish a 6-run over.
On a length and around off, blocked from the back foot to point.

FOUR! Not from the middle of the bat but the connection is enough. Fuller and around off at 133 kph, Young just goes through with his shot, hits it cross the line from the bottom half of his bat and the ball flies over wide mid on. It finds the fence after that with ease and in a hurry.
Slower one, short and outside off at 111.9 kph, Guptill plays late and glides it to third man for a run.
Short in length from Logan van Beek, Will Young fetches it from outside off and pulls it to deep square leg for a run.
Angles in a length ball on off, Young defends it from the back foot to mid on.
The length is dragged back, around off and turning in, Will goes on the back foot and turns it behind square leg for one. 7 from Dutt's first.
Once again it's too full and around off, Young stretches forward and sweeps it in front of square on the leg side for a couple.
Too full on this occasion, around off, Martin Guptill flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Gets on the front foot and defends it with the spin to the leg side.
Slower through the air, landing full around off and turning down, Guptill tries to defend but it takes the inside edge and runs down to fine leg for two.
Flighted off spinner, starting from around off, it's helped behind square leg for a run.
Aryan Dutt is brought into the attack.
Width there outside off, short again, Guptill hammers it off his back foot but it goes on one bounce to the point fielder.
Back of a length, outside off, Guptill chops it down in front of short third man and looks for a run. He is sent back.
Fuller and outside off, Young uses his feet and drags his attempted flick shot to deep square leg for a run.
Beaten! van Beek bowls a sharp delivery, a touch short and around off, Young tries to guide it down to third man but is beaten.
Angling down towards leg, it's eased down through mid on for a single.
Begins a new spell with a near-yorker on middle, Young works it in front of square leg for a single.
Short and outside off, Guptill cuts but finds the point fielder. 10 from the over!
Flighted and on off, defended back to the bowler.
On middle, and spinning down, clipped behind square leg for a run.
Rippon comes from over the wicket and delivers it close to off, Guptill plays late and guides it wide of short third man for a run.

FOUR! Consecutive boundaries. Michael Rippon overcorrects his line and length. Goes full and down the leg side, Guptill goes down and thumps it via a sweep shot to the long leg fence. 7000 ODI runs for Martin now, a great feat!
FOUR! Excellent shot! Rippon bowls the one that turns back in but the line is outside off and the length is short. Guptill camps back and whacks it behind backward point.
Angling in around off, fuller in length. Will Young blocks it out.
Full delivery, darting it on the pads. Martin Guptill works it away to deep mid-wicket for a single.

Pitches it up this time, width on offer. Will Young drives it towards cover-point and takes a single. Fifty for Will Young as well! He notched up a ton in the first game and now he brings up a half century. It's been a good knock from him. He will want to carry on!
Good-length delivery, outside off. Will Young stays in his crease and taps it towards point.
A slower ball now, angling in on the pads, on a good length. Martin Guptill tucks it towards square leg for a single.
Full in length, around off. Martin Guptill blocks it out watchfully.
Another shorter ball, spinning in from outside off. Martin Guptill swivels and pulls it towards the fielder at deep mid-wicket. Single, 9 from the over!
Tad shorter, a googly, around off. Martin Guptill taps it towards point.
Fuller, darting it on the pads. Will Young tucks it towards square leg for a single.

SIX! BOOM! Great use of the feet once again! A fuller ball, loopy delivery, around off and turning in. Will Young dances down the track, gets to the pitch of the ball, and tonks it over the bowler's head for a biggie. That brings up the 100-run partnership between these two!
Another fuller ball, around off. Martin Guptill gets down on his knee and sweeps it towards deep square leg. Single taken!
Tosses it up, full, around off. Martin Guptill leans and blocks it out towards point.
Length, around middle and leg. Martin Guptill dabs it towards backward point for a single.
Angling in around middle, on a length. Martin Guptill defends it out towards the leg side.
Wide! Fred Klaassen drops it short now, down the leg side. Martin Guptill leaves it alone. Wide given both for line and height!
Another good-length delivery, shaping away, outside off. Martin Guptill lets that go through to the keeper.
On a length, outside off. Will Young opens the face of the bat and guides it to third man. Single taken!
Fred Klaassen pitches it up again, around off. Martin Guptill strokes it towards mid off and scampers through to the other end.
Tad fuller, outside off. Martin Guptill blocks it towards point.
Fred Klaassen (4-0-16-1) is back into the attack.
This one turns in, around middle and leg. Martin Guptill tucks it towards square leg for a single. He retains the strike!
Lovely delivery! Tosses it up, full, and a googly this time! Martin Guptill leans to block this, but he misses as the ball spins away from him.
A fuller ball from 'round the wicket, around middle. Will Young knocks it towards long on for a single.
Fullish and on off, swept through square leg for a single.
Michael Rippon comes from 'round the wicket and delivers it full and outside off, turning in, Guptill defends off his front foot.
Fuller ball, tosses it up, on middle. Will Young nudges it towards short fine leg for a run.

SIX! BANG! A gift to Martin Guptill! A shorter ball, around middle. Martin Guptill swivels and pulls it over deep mid-wicket for a biggie! That is fifty for Martin Guptill as well! Much needed fifty for him, he had not been scoring runs consistently. A fine knock by him so far and he would be aiming a big one now!
Shorter ball, wide of off. Will Young stays in his crease and slashes it past point. The fielder from sweeper runs to his left, dives, and makes a good stop. Three taken!
Make that four! A flatter ball, full, around middle. Will Young defends it out.
Slower through the air, full, outside off. Will Young advances down the track and taps it towards point. 3 dots in a row now!
Shorter ball now, spinning away, outside off. Will Young pushes it to the fielder at cover.
Tosses it up, full, around middle. Will Young steps down the pitch and pushes it back to the bowler.

FOUR! Well played! Rippon pulls his length back again but this time the line is on leg, Guptill goes down on one knee and drags his sweep shot off the inner half to fine leg. Boundaries have started to come for the Black Caps after a dry spell.
Leans forward to a full ball and flicks it to mid-wicket.
Nicely flighted, pulling his length back a bit around middle, Guptill gets back and defends it down.
Tossed up, full and on middle, worked to the left side of the short fine leg fielder for a quick run.
FOUR! Shot! Quick use of the feet from Will Young. He advances down the track to a full ball around off and lofts it behind the bowler's head for a boundary.
Floated delivery, full and around leg, Guptill sweeps it all along the ground through backward square leg for a single.
Loopy and around off, Young uses his feet again but drives it straight to the cover fielder.
Short this time, outside off, cut but straight to point.
Quicker through the air, full and on middle, defended down.
Strides forward to a full ball and pushes it through point for a single.
FOUR! Sweetly timed! Too full and around middle and leg, skidding down, Guptill goes down on one knee and sweeps it behind square leg for a boundary.
Flighted one, full and on off, Young walks down the track and plays a check-drive through covers for a run.
Slower through the air, full and on off, Guptill presses forward and defends it down safely.
Soft hands. Young uses the spin and works it to the right of the mid-wicket fielder for a quick run.
Flighted and full, around off, Young uses his feet but flicks it straight to mid-wicket.
Drags his length back a bit and delivers it around leg, Martin Guptill goes back and tucks it to deep square leg for one.
Tossed up, landing full on middle, Guptill flicks but finds mid-wicket.
Loopy one, full and around leg, it's nudged behind square leg for a single.
Michael Rippon comes into the attack. A leg slip in place.
Walks down the track to take it on the full and hits it towards long off for a single.
Flatter one, around middle and skidding in, Martin Guptill tries to defend but it takes the inner edge and rolls behind square leg for one.
Arm ball, full and around middle, it's swept towards short fine leg where the fielder stops it with a dive. They cross.
A long hop on off, Martin Guptill goes back and pulls it to deep square leg for a run.
Loopy and full, around off, defended to covers.
Flighted delivery, a touch short and on middle, Young goes deep inside the crease and punches it to sweeper cover for a run.

DRINKS! After losing an early wicket, Martin Guptill and Henry Nicholls have done to rebuild the innings. They are not scoring at a brisk rate, but they are getting the scoreboard ticking. The duo is probably being watchful because of their collapse in the previous game. They will aim to go big towards the end! Netherlands will want to break this partnership and try to take things under control.
Continues to take the pace off. Short and outside off, Young guides it down to third man for a single.
Another slower one, loopy and full on off, it's knocked down to long on for a run.
Slower off cutter, on a shortish length outside off, Will cuts it through point and picks up a single.
Goes fuller and on off, Young pushes it out but finds the fielder at mid on.
Wide called for height! A bumper has gone well over the head of the batter. Netherlands have bowled too many extras.
This one is angling down the leg side, Guptill helps it behind square leg and rotates the strike.
On a length, around off and angling in, Young takes a step forward and across before tucking it in front of square leg for a run.
Tosses it up, fuller ball, spinning away a tad, outside off. Martin Guptill taps it towards point. 3 runs off Pieter Seelaar's first over!
Flatter delivery now, around middle. Martin Guptill pushes it towards covers off the back foot.
Slower through the air, tosses it up, full, on middle. Martin Guptill lunges forward and blocks it out.
Loopy delivery, full, around off. Will Young drives it towards cover for a single.
Fullish delivery now, turns away, outside off. Martin Guptill taps it towards short third man for a single. That brings up the 50-run partnership between these two!
Pieter Seelaar begins with a shorter ball, spinning away, outside off. Will Young punches it towards sweeper cover for a single.
Change in bowling. Pieter Seelaar brings himself into the attack now.
Angling in outside off, on a length. Will Young stays in his crease and eases it down to third man for a single.
On a length, outside off. Will Young taps it towards backward point. No run taken!
The physio comes out to perform the mandatory concussion check. Martin Guptill is fine!
Leg bye! Takes the pace off now, a short ball. Martin Guptill misses his pull and gets hit on the helmet. The ball goes towards point and the batters steal a leg bye.
No ball! A shorter ball, around middle and off. Martin Guptill sways away and leaves it alone. Bas de Leede has overstepped and a no ball is called! Free Hit coming up!
Another length delivery, width on offer this time. Will Young steers it towards third man for a single.
On a length again, outside off. Martin Guptill dabs it towards gully and takes a single.
Good-length delivery, around off. Martin Guptill shows the full face of the bat and defends it out.
Loopy delivery, very full, around middle. Martin Guptill knocks it towards long off and takes a single. He retains the strike.
Full, outside off. Will Young drives it through covers and rotates the strike!
FOUR! Lovely shot! Tosses it up, full, around middle, Will Young advances down the pitch and whips it past mid-wicket for a boundary. 50 up!
Slower through the air, on the pads, fuller ball. Martin Guptill leans and tucks it towards square leg for a single.
Short this time, spinning away, outside off. Will Young punches it towards sweeper cover for a single.
Tosses it up, full, on middle. Will Young strokes it back to the bowler.
Fuller length delivery, around middle, Will Young pushes it with the inner half of his bat towards mid-wicket and takes a single.
Tad fuller now, outside off. Will Young leans and pushes it towards covers.
Angling in around middle, on a good length. Will Young flicks it past square leg. Misfield in the deep, two taken!
Swing a miss! Outside off, on a length, swinging away a tad. Will Young tries to cut this but he misses.
A replica of the previous delivery! Short in length, around middle and off. Will Young goes for the pull shot, but once again he fails to get any bat on it.
Bas de Leede drops it short again, around middle, Will Young goes for the pull shot but he misses. Nothing off the Free Hit!
Wide! Very short this time, outside off. Will Young leaves it alone. The keeper fumbles but no run taken. Wide called! Free Hit stands!
Serves it on a good length and outside off, Martin Guptill pushes it through covers for a run. Called a no ball for overstepping. Free Hit to follow...
Shorter ball, this one comes in with the angle, around middle. Will Young pushes it back to the bowler. 9 from the over!
Another fuller delivery, outside off. Will Young pushes it towards the fielder at covers.
Fuller, outside off. Martin Guptill drives through covers for a single.
BEAUTY! What a peach of a delivery! Loopy ball, this one lands around middle, and spins away outside off. Martin Guptill leans to block this but he gets beaten on the outside edge.

FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! Down the leg side now, fuller ball. Martin Guptill just pushes it past the keeper towards fine leg. The fielder gives the chase but puts in an awkward dive as he misses the ball. A boundary results.
FOUR! Streaky! A loopy delivery, full, outside off. Martin Guptill leans to drive, but the ball goes off the outside edge just away from the slip fielder, towards third man, for a boundary.
Time for Powerplay 2! Now, 4 fielders will be allowed outside the circle till the 40th over!

Miscued in the air and Guptill is lucky to survive. Short in length and on off, Martin Guptill mistimes his pull shot in the air and it falls in no man's land at mid on. They cross. At the end of Powerplay 1, New Zealand are 32/1.
Around off, pushed off the back foot to covers.
Guptill wants to capitalize, he steps back to make room but the bowler smartly delivers it short and wide outside off. Martin leaves.
Fractionally short and on off, Martin punches off the back foot but finds the cover fielder. He has picked out that fielder quite a few times already.
This one is served on a driving length outside off, skidding off the surface after landing, Guptill watches it closely and leaves.
Risky single! Full in length, around off, Young bunts it down to mid on and rushes across to the other end. Floyd scores a direct hit at the bowler's end but Will is safe.
Another bowling change! Bas de Leede comes to bowl now.
Loopy this time, full and on off, Martin Guptill drives it off his front foot but finds the cover fielder. A tidy start from Clayton Floyd!
Floyd goes short and wide outside off, Guptill cuts but mistimes it towards cover-point.
Slower through the air, drifting in and landing in the blockhole, Guptill digs it out back to the bowler.
Too full this time, the line is straight and it has been swept through square leg for a run.
Flatter and a touch short, outside off, Young uses the pace and plays it late to guide it past backward point. Two taken.
Tossed up, full and around off, Young drives but finds the fielder at cover-point.
First bowling change! It's time for some spin as Clayton Floyd comes into the attack.
Back of a length, around off and angling in, Guptill strokes it off his back foot but finds the cover fielder. Top over from Logan!
Angles it in, on a fuller length around middle, Guptill shows the full face of the bat and defends it back.
Pitches it up and outside off, Martin drives but finds the mid off fielder.
The line is too straight and Young clips it through square leg for a run.
Once again Young remains on the back foot and plays it down with an angled bat to gully.
On a length and close to off, Young plays it close to his body and drops it down towards gully.
Takes the pace off this one and lands it full around off, Martin pushes it to cover-point.
FOUR! Shot of the day so far! A bit too full and around off, Guptill leans forward and caresses it through the gap at mid off for a glorious boundary.
Shortish and on off, tapped down to point.
A mistimed back-foot punch by Young but it goes over the cover fielder, they take a run.
Presses forward to a full ball and pushes it to covers.
Angling away from the batter, outside off, Young leaves.
Extra bounce again, outside off, Young has a tame push inside the line and edges it wide of the slip fielder. It runs down to third man and they cross.
Fuller and on middle, bunted down to mid on for a brisk single.
Oohhh... Guptill is saved by the bounce. Beautiful delivery, a touch short in length and outside off, Guptill decides to leave it on line but it jags back in and goes over the off stump.
Lands it full and outside off, Martin drives it on the up but doesn't find the gap at covers.
Short and outside off, Guptill leaves.
Wide called for height! A bouncer, going over the head of Guptill who ducks.
Fullish and outside off, slower in pace, Young tries to drive and edges it down to third man for a run.
FOUR! Easy pickings for Martin Guptill! On a length, darting it on the hips. Martin Guptill tucks it fine towards fine leg for a boundary.
On a length, outside off. Martin Guptill defends it off the outer half of his bat towards gully.
Fuller delivery, angling in around middle and leg. Will Young flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single. He gets off the mark!
Will Young is the number 3 batter.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Fred Klaassen strikes and draws first blood! Good start for the Netherlands, this is just what they wanted. An early breakthrough as Henry Nicholls departs for a timid score. Fred Klaassen drops it short, outside off. Henry Nicholls looks to pull this but he manages to only get a faint edge back to the keeper. Scott Edwards pouches it safely. Huge shout for a caught behind! It's not given. The Dutch players are sure that Henry Nicholls has nicked it and Pieter Seelaar has gone for the DRS. It's very close to the bat as Nicholls attempts to pull. The UltraEdge comes in and finds a spike. Henry Nicholls walks back!
Commentary.Howout: c Scott Edwards b Fred Klaassen

Commentary.Commentary: Length delivery, outside off. Henry Nicholls leans and defends it out.
Good-length delivery, shaping away outside off. Henry Nicholls taps it on the off side off the back foot.
Angling in around middle and leg, on a good length. Martin Guptill blocks it out.
Swing and a miss! A fuller ball, swinging away, outside off. Martin Guptill lunges forward and looks to drive this but he misses.

FOUR! Lucky boundary! A shorter ball, down leg. Martin Guptill looks to pull this but he bails out, the ball deflects off his gloves and goes towards the fine leg fence for a boundary. First boundary of the innings!
An outswinger this time, outside off, on a length. Martin Guptill leaves it alone.
Lovely delivery! On a length, tailing back in sharply. Martin Guptill presses forward and looks to defend this but he misses and gets hit high on his pads.
Back of a length, around middle. Henry Nicholls pulls it towards deep square leg. Single taken!
Fred Klaassen drops it short now, around middle. Martin Guptill ducks under it.
Good-length delivery, around off. Martin Guptill defends it out solidly.
Another length delivery, outside off. Martin Guptill taps it towards point. No run there!
Fuller delivery now, outside off. Martin Guptill drives it towards sweeper cover. Two runs taken!
Wide! Too short on this occasion, around middle. Martin Guptill looks to pull this but he misses. Wide called for height! Free Hit continues!
No ball! On a length, outside off. Martin Guptill leaves it alone. Fred Klaassen has overstepped here and a no ball is given. Free Hit to follow!
Yorker-length delivery, around middle, at 129.4 clicks. Martin Guptill digs it out.
Fuller ball, around middle. Martin Guptill pushes it towards mid on.

Swing and a miss! Another length delivery, a hint of away movement, outside off. Henry Nicholls looks to cut this away, but he gets beaten on the outside edge. Just one extra in the over, Logan van Beek begins well.
Shaping away, outside off, on a length. Henry Nicholls leaves it alone.
Wide! On a length, down the leg side. Henry Nicholls looks to flick this but he misses. Wide given!
Back of a length, outside off. Henry Nicholls pushes it towards point off the back foot.
Well bowled! Extra bounce there for Logan van Beek! Fraction shorter, nipping in, around middle. Henry Nicholls does well to just fend it out.
Good-length delivery, around middle and leg. Henry Nicholls taps it towards mid-wicket.
Logan van Beek starts off with a length delivery, swinging away, around off. Henry Nicholls stays in his crease and blocks it out.
Will Netherlands bowl spin from the other end? Nopes, it is going to be the pace of Logan van Beek.
A length delivery, outside off, at around 124 clicks. Martin Guptill taps it towards point. 2 runs off the first over!
Fred Klaassen drops it short now, around off. Martin Guptill leans back and lets that go through.
Good-length delivery, around middle. Martin Guptill defends it out.
On a length, swinging away on the pads, at 128.2 clicks. Henry Nicholls pushes it towards deep square leg for a single. Henry Nicholls gets off the mark!
Fred Klaassen pitches it up again, shaping away outside off. Henry Nicholls leaves it alone.
Fred Klaassen begins with a fuller ball, swinging in, outside off. Martin Guptill leans and taps it towards covers for a single. Martin Guptill and New Zealand are up and running straightaway!

We are ready for the match! The players are out in the middle. Martin Guptill and Henry Nicholls will open the batting for New Zealand. Fred Klaassen will begin the proceedings with the ball. Let's go!

The players have made their way out in the middle for the national anthems. It's a bit odd to have it in the final ODI but it was requested by Ross Taylor. One final time for the big man with his boys and he has his kids alongside as well. Truly an emotional moment.

Netherlands (Playing XI) - Stephan Myburgh, Max O'Dowd, Vikramjit Singh, Bas de Leede, Scott Edwards (WK), Michael Rippon, Pieter Seelaar (C), Logan van Beek, Aryan Dutt, Fred Klaassen, Clayton Floyd (In for Brandon Glover).

New Zealand (Playing XI) - Martin Guptill, Henry Nicholls, Will Young, Ross Taylor, Tom Latham (C/WK), Michael Bracewell, Colin de Grandhomme, Doug Bracewell, Ish Sodhi, Kyle Jamieson, Matt Henry (In for Blair Tickner).
TOSS - New Zealand have won the toss and they have elected to BAT first.

Netherlands have shown glimpses of how threatening they can be with the ball in the previous game. However, it’s their batting that has been a concern and they will want to step up in this final game and give a tough fight to the opposition. The visitors will have to bring their A-game forward to come out on top this time and avoid a whitewash. Will they get over the line this time? We will find out. Stay tuned for the toss and other updates...

New Zealand have put up dominating performances in both the games and have clinched the series with ease. Although they were in a lot of trouble in the previous game after losing half their side within 10 overs, Tom Latham guided his side to a healthy total of 264 and the bowlers did the rest. Their bowling unit has been exceptional so far and they will want to replicate the same coming into this final game. This will also mark Ross Taylor's final international game. With over 8500 runs in One Day Internationals, he will be ending his career as the highest run-scorer for New Zealand. Today will be the last time we see Ross Taylor in action!

Hello and a warm welcome to the third and the final ODI of this exciting series between New Zealand and Netherlands. The hosts have taken an unassailable 2-0 lead in this series, while the Netherlands have not been able to get over the line yet. However, they will be hoping to win the last ODI and end this series on a positive note.
... MATCH DAY ...
